plugins.name: glm-statusline
plugins.description: Configurable GLM / Z.ai usage status line for Claude Code. Displays 5H quota, MCP/tools quota, context usage, session tokens, day/30D usage, and model name. Includes interactive field selector, terminal-width auto-wrapping, and a plan-details command.
